headline.text: L3 ML1 lost *10 hours* to mold demolding failures — now running with portable heater workaround at reduced speed

per_plant_summary.L1: S4 chiller failed twice in 24 hours — fixed at 16:12 yesterday, down again at 08:15 for freon fill. S2 stopped 20 minutes on low temper at 08:40, cleared. S4 slitters damaged at 08:35, 9 blades replaced. S3 and S2 ran caramel with routine quality checks.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML3 demolder jammed three times between 08:06 and 10:11, maintenance adjusting. Almond sorting running at 15% reject versus 1.5% spec — Candon set intentionally high. FFS lost 11 minutes at 17:34 yesterday on lot print defects, cleared. ML2 routine.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML1 fought demolding failures from 23:08 yesterday through 10:34 today — 20 of 20 test molds stuck at 04:24, all molds cleaned, decision at 10:34 to run with yellow portable heater. ML4 depositor 1 not purging since 07:56, calling WDS hotline at 10:34. Truffle line inherited 27 bins and dirty Cavannas at 07:13, took reheat to recover, M4 belt needs replacement.

notes.text: S3 production count discrepancy flagged at 11:07 — countdown showed 1199 quarter-pallets needed, system showed 637.
Two almond totes received without LPNs; after Candon and Hervin discussion, decision to discard for traceability.
Nathan Ruiz confirmed M4 belt tightened all the way, estimates 4 hours to replace; Chris Givens scuffing drive roller as temporary fix.

resolved.title: S4 chiller not reaching tunnel temp
resolved.summary: Tunnels could not cool caramel, maintenance suspected low freon; line paused at 13:01 on 8/31 to troubleshoot.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 16:12 on 8/31 — "fixed awhile ago, seems like it was a sticking solenoid valve" (Caleb York).

resolved.title: S2 temper readings 1.1, line stopped
resolved.summary: Two consecutive temper readings of 1.1 at 08:40 forced line stop; out of acceptable range for enrobing.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 09:02 — Curt Willis adjusted setpoint to 27, line restarted.

resolved.title: ML3 demolder plate stuck
resolved.summary: Mold plate jammed in demolder at 08:06, line down while maintenance worked to free.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 08:25 — "The line is running" (Molding Line 3 Pack).

resolved.title: FFS lot printing defects on bags
resolved.summary: Machine down at 17:34 yesterday, lot numbers printing light and misplaced every 20 bags; quality risk.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 17:45 yesterday — Brandon Lance reported running again on new roll with no issues, defective bags pulled.

resolved.title: ML1 hopper flapper mechanism preventing almond feed
resolved.summary: Pneu-Con hopper flapper bent during install, not closing fully; almonds not flowing to depositor.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 03:55 on 8/31 — "We have initiated the chocolate deposition process" (Bojana McLeod) after cleaning flapper and capture testing.

resolved.title: Truffle M6 belt chocolate misalignment causing rejects
resolved.summary: Chocolate turning sideways on belt M6, sensor rejecting pieces; throughput and scrap impact.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 12:31 on 8/31 — "The chocolates are better aligned now, and the sensor isn't rejecting them" (TruffleLine FW).

resolved.title: ML1 THS metal detector wrong recipe
resolved.summary: Metal detector set for Feastables product, not reading Hershey test cards; validation blocked.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 22:33 on 8/31 — Angel Cabrera changed recipe to Hershey, all three cards read and rejected.

resolved.title: ML1 Donner belt 3 frayed and shifted north
resolved.summary: Transfer belt moved out of position and frayed at edge, risking product jam or belt failure.

resolved.title: ML1 Imperial demolding belt shifted south
resolved.summary: Demolding conveyor tracking south, risking mold misalignment and jams.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 09:19 — "Demolding belt is good to go" (Nathan Ruiz).

needs_attention.title: S4 chiller failing again — freon fill in progress
needs_attention.summary: Chiller could not reach temp at 08:15, line paused; same unit that failed yesterday with sticking solenoid; now suspected low refrigerant.
needs_attention.status: HVAC tech in middle of freon fill at 11:09, will inspect S4 after lunch per Matt Hatch.

needs_attention.title: S4 slitter — 4 blades damaged
needs_attention.summary: Four slitter blades damaged at 08:35, no product ran through; line disassembled for repair.
needs_attention.status: 9 blades replaced as of 10:38; no indication line restarted by window close.

needs_attention.title: S2 MM6 seal bar issues, unauthorized cam changes
needs_attention.summary: Seal bar problems on MM6 at 10:33; cam settings changed without CL documentation or Teams post; Troy Baxter flagged settings mismatch with MM7.
needs_attention.status: Passwords need changed again per Chris Jeffs at 10:41; product reported underweight with low almonds at 11:20.

needs_attention.title: Almond sorting reject rate 15% versus 1.5% spec
needs_attention.summary: Optical sorter rejecting 15% across four totes versus 1.5% supplier spec; Gustavo flagged at 09:02 and again at 05:59.
needs_attention.status: Candon confirmed at 08:14 that Scott Maxfield wanted 15% reject; Chad at 03:23 suggested segregating anything over 10% to re-sort.

needs_attention.title: ML3 demolder jamming repeatedly
needs_attention.summary: Mold jams at 08:06, 08:28, 08:56; cleared each time but recurring; Justin Barney adjusting demolder as of 10:11.
needs_attention.status: Line still down at 10:11, Justin adjusting demolder per last message in window.

needs_attention.title: ML1 molds not demolding — 10-hour troubleshoot
needs_attention.summary: Bars sticking to molds starting 23:08 yesterday; 20/20 test molds failed at 04:24, all molds washed, multiple speed and temp trials, decision at 10:34 to run with yellow portable mold heater.
needs_attention.status: Running test at 10 mpm with portable heater as of 10:34; Chad Stone directed to move forward with heater versus further optimization attempts.

needs_attention.title: ML4 depositor 1 piston servo drive faulty
needs_attention.summary: Depositor 1 will not purge after physical swap with depositor 4 at 09:53; programming issue suspected, WDS called overnight.
needs_attention.status: Nelson Cook requested to call US WDS hotline at 10:34; depositor 4 now working, depositor 1 still down.

needs_attention.title: Truffle line left with 27 bins, dirty Cavannas
needs_attention.summary: Third shift handed off 27 bins of accumulation and very dirty Cavanna machines at 07:13; first shift paused to clean and took reheat.
needs_attention.status: Reheat completed, line restarted at 10:07 with temper; Grey noted significant chocolate buildup on wire mesh required intervention.

needs_attention.title: Truffle M4 belt insufficient tension, not spreading product
needs_attention.summary: Belt M4 running same speed as M3 despite setting 11 vs 3; chocolate backing up onto M5, misaligning by M6, sensor rejecting.
needs_attention.status: Nathan Ruiz tightened fully, confirmed belt needs replacement — 4-hour job; Chris Givens scuffed drive roller as temporary fix at 10:23.
